symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The two-point map sending a pair of values to their half-sum and half-difference.
symbols.quote: A butterfly is the two-point map $H_0(\xi,\eta)=\left(\frac{\xi+\eta}{2},\frac{\xi-\eta}{2}\right)$, which replaces a pair of values by their half-sum and half-difference.

symbols.name: first input value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two values that the butterfly takes as input.
symbols.quote: Here $\xi$ and $\eta$ are the two input values

symbols.name: second input value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two values that the butterfly takes as input.
symbols.quote: Here $\xi$ and $\eta$ are the two input values

relations.quote: The butterfly is an elementary step of the [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md)
